notes.ndvi: How green the trees look from space. Compare this grove with its own earlier photos, not with other groves.
notes.ndvi-change: Difference from the last clear satellite photo. Near zero means little change.
notes.ndmi: Moisture in the leaves, not water deep in the soil. It moves after rain or irrigation.
notes.ndre: Leaf colour in thick canopy, useful when the trees are very leafy.
notes.ndwi: Highlights puddles and very wet ground.
notes.savi: Greenness that ignores bare soil, helpful in young or widely spaced groves.
notes.land-cover: A 2021 map of what covered the ground. Newer planting or clearing will not show yet.
